$comment: Seed data for examples/bike-workshop, posted by scripts/demo-admin in the order below. '$key' names a row so later rows can point at it: '@ref:<key>' becomes that row's id, '@user:<email>' the id of the sign-in account created under 'users'. '@date:<n>' is today plus n days and '@datetime:<n>T<hh:mm>' that day at that time (UTC), so the demo always looks current. '$key' is stripped before a row is sent.

rows.notes: Prefers to be called after 16:00, works shifts at the hospital.
Rides for MTB klub Banská Bystrica. Races XC most weekends — always asks for express.
Commutes to Sliač airport daily, cannot be without a bike for more than two days.
Team rider, enduro. Bring fork issues to Peter.
